Tor is an old Germanic god.
He is the god of the weather.
Tor is big and strong and helpful.
Then he throws a hammer at the enemy.
sentences.Hammeren treffer alltid – og den kommer: The hammer always hits – and it always comes back to Tor afterwards!
sentences.Tor kjører over himmelen i ei vogn med t: Tor drives across the sky in a chariot pulled by two billy goats.
sentences.Han lager mye bråk, og da blir det torde: He makes a lot of noise, and that's what makes thunder.
